# Rules

ContractGuard 1.0.0 has **83 rules**. Each finding names its rule, so `contractguard explain <rule-id>` or the pages below tell you exactly what was detected and why.

A rule decides the **classification** of a change from the compatibility perspective (default: *provider-backward*: can existing consumers keep working?). The severity follows from the classification and the rule's severity profile. See [Classification and severity](/concepts/classification).

## Operations and paths {#api}

Operations, paths and methods that consumers call. 7 rules.

| Rule | Name | Detects |
|---|---|---|
| [CG-API-001](./CG-API-001) | Operation removed | An operation in the baseline has no counterpart in the candidate. |
| [CG-API-002](./CG-API-002) | Operation added | The candidate adds a new operation. |
| [CG-API-003](./CG-API-003) | Operation path changed (probable rename) | A removed operation matches an added one by operationId or a case/trailing-slash difference. |
| [CG-API-004](./CG-API-004) | Operation deprecation changed | The deprecated flag of an operation was toggled. |
| [CG-API-005](./CG-API-005) | Path parameter renamed | A path template variable changed name at the same position. |
| [CG-API-006](./CG-API-006) | operationId changed | The same operation has a different operationId. |
| [CG-API-007](./CG-API-007) | Callback definitions changed | Callbacks on an operation differ; callbacks are not analyzed in v1. |

## Servers {#srv}

Where the API is served. 3 rules.

| Rule | Name | Detects |
|---|---|---|
| [CG-SRV-001](./CG-SRV-001) | Server removed | A server URL present in the baseline is absent from the candidate. |
| [CG-SRV-002](./CG-SRV-002) | Server base path changed | A server's base path no longer exists in the candidate, so operation URLs move. |
| [CG-SRV-003](./CG-SRV-003) | Server variable values narrowed | A server variable's enum lost values. |

## Requests {#req}

What consumers send: parameters, headers, bodies. 34 rules.

| Rule | Name | Detects |
|---|---|---|
| [CG-REQ-001](./CG-REQ-001) | New required request body property | A property was added to a request schema and is required. |
| [CG-REQ-002](./CG-REQ-002) | Request parameter became required | An existing optional parameter is now required. |
| [CG-REQ-003](./CG-REQ-003) | Request body property became required | An existing optional request property is now required. |
| [CG-REQ-004](./CG-REQ-004) | New required request parameter | A new required query, header or cookie parameter. |
| [CG-REQ-005](./CG-REQ-005) | New optional request input | An optional parameter or optional request property was added. |
| [CG-REQ-006](./CG-REQ-006) | Request parameter removed | A documented parameter no longer exists. |
| [CG-REQ-007](./CG-REQ-007) | Request parameter location changed | A parameter with the same name moved to a different location (query, header, path, cookie). |
| [CG-REQ-008](./CG-REQ-008) | Request parameter became optional | A required parameter is now optional. |
| [CG-REQ-009](./CG-REQ-009) | Request parameter serialization changed | The effective style, explode, allowReserved or content media type of a parameter changed. |
| [CG-REQ-010](./CG-REQ-010) | Request body became required | The request body is now required. |
| [CG-REQ-011](./CG-REQ-011) | Request body became optional | The request body is no longer required. |
| [CG-REQ-012](./CG-REQ-012) | Request body added | The operation previously had no request body. |
| [CG-REQ-013](./CG-REQ-013) | Request body removed | The operation no longer documents a request body. |
| [CG-REQ-014](./CG-REQ-014) | Request media type removed | The request body no longer accepts a media type. |
| [CG-REQ-015](./CG-REQ-015) | Request media type added | The request body accepts a new media type. |
| [CG-REQ-020](./CG-REQ-020) | Request enum value removed | A request value is restricted to fewer enumerated values. |
| [CG-REQ-021](./CG-REQ-021) | Request enum value added | A request value accepts more enumerated values (or the enum was removed). |
| [CG-REQ-022](./CG-REQ-022) | Request type narrowed | The JSON types accepted in a request shrank. |
| [CG-REQ-023](./CG-REQ-023) | Request type widened | The JSON types accepted in a request grew. |
| [CG-REQ-024](./CG-REQ-024) | Request value constraint tightened | A numeric, length, size or uniqueness constraint on request values became stricter. |
| [CG-REQ-025](./CG-REQ-025) | Request value constraint relaxed | A request constraint became looser or a pattern was removed. |
| [CG-REQ-026](./CG-REQ-026) | Request pattern added | A regular-expression pattern now restricts a request string. |
| [CG-REQ-027](./CG-REQ-027) | Request pattern changed | A request string pattern was replaced by a different one. |
| [CG-REQ-028](./CG-REQ-028) | Request format changed | The `format` of a request value changed. |
| [CG-REQ-029](./CG-REQ-029) | Request property disallowed | A property old requests could send is now rejected. |
| [CG-REQ-030](./CG-REQ-030) | Request property removed from open schema | A property was removed from a request schema that still allows additional properties. |
| [CG-REQ-031](./CG-REQ-031) | Request no longer accepts null | A request value that allowed null no longer does. |
| [CG-REQ-032](./CG-REQ-032) | Request variant removed | A oneOf/anyOf branch of a request schema has no counterpart in the candidate. |
| [CG-REQ-033](./CG-REQ-033) | Request oneOf variant added without discriminator | A oneOf branch was added to a request schema that has no discriminator. |
| [CG-REQ-034](./CG-REQ-034) | Request composition widened | An anyOf branch, a discriminated oneOf branch was added, or a non-mergeable allOf branch removed. |
| [CG-REQ-035](./CG-REQ-035) | Request discriminator value removed | A discriminator mapping value of a request schema was removed. |
| [CG-REQ-036](./CG-REQ-036) | Request default value changed | The default of a request parameter or property changed. |
| [CG-REQ-037](./CG-REQ-037) | Request property became read-only | A request property gained readOnly. |
| [CG-REQ-038](./CG-REQ-038) | Request allOf constraint added | A non-mergeable allOf branch was added to a request schema. |

## Schemas {#schema}

Schema-level changes that are not tied to one direction. 6 rules.

| Rule | Name | Detects |
|---|---|---|
| [CG-SCHEMA-001](./CG-SCHEMA-001) | Incompatible type change | The base and candidate type sets are disjoint. |
| [CG-SCHEMA-002](./CG-SCHEMA-002) | Schema representation changed (equivalent) | The schema is spelled differently but means the same. |
| [CG-SCHEMA-900](./CG-SCHEMA-900) | Unsupported schema construct changed | A schema keyword ContractGuard does not analyze changed. |
| [CG-SCHEMA-901](./CG-SCHEMA-901) | Composition not analyzable | Composition branches could not be matched reliably. |
| [CG-SCHEMA-902](./CG-SCHEMA-902) | Analysis budget exceeded | Schema comparison stopped at the configured limit. |
| [CG-SCHEMA-903](./CG-SCHEMA-903) | Unresolved reference in compared schema | A compared schema contains a reference that could not be resolved. |

## Security {#auth}

Security schemes, scopes and requirements. 6 rules.

| Rule | Name | Detects |
|---|---|---|
| [CG-AUTH-001](./CG-AUTH-001) | Authentication requirement tightened | Some baseline credential no longer works, or anonymous access was removed. |
| [CG-AUTH-002](./CG-AUTH-002) | Additional scopes required | The same schemes are required, with more scopes. |
| [CG-AUTH-003](./CG-AUTH-003) | Authentication relaxed | Every baseline credential still works and more are accepted. |
| [CG-AUTH-004](./CG-AUTH-004) | Security scheme changed incompatibly | A scheme's type, apiKey name/location, HTTP scheme or OpenID Connect URL changed. |
| [CG-AUTH-005](./CG-AUTH-005) | OAuth2 flow changed | An OAuth2 flow was removed, its URLs changed or declared scopes removed (or only descriptive fields changed). |
| [CG-AUTH-006](./CG-AUTH-006) | Security scheme renamed | A security scheme was renamed with an identical definition. |
